On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 11:03 AM Sylvia Hayes <sylvia.hayes@retailco.com> wrote:
> Can we stagger signature routing so legal signs first, then Head of Data, then procurement?

Yes — DocuSign supports sequential routing. Recommendation: route Legal (Jonathan) -> Head of Data (Priya) -> Procurement distribution list. That matches RetailCo’s PO trigger and avoids parallel signing that would still block procurement. Notes: 

- DocuSign envelope: include conditional tags for the PO number field so procurement cannot complete without the PO attached.
- Timezone/availability: Jonathan is on ET; if we send Thu 10am PT (1pm ET) he has until 2pm ET to sign same day for procurement processing. If legal delays past 2pm ET, procurement will still show next-business-day processing (Sylvia already noted).
- Security/Legal: if RetailCo legal returns a redline to the SLA retention paragraph, route the redline directly to our Security Counsel (security@redwood.com) and cc Sales — that will keep the cycle tight.

Operational ask for you, Logan: prepare two DocuSign envelopes — one sequential (canonical) and a fallback parallel envelope (only used if legal explicitly requests parallel sign). Also prepare an onboarding kickoff calendar invite for Mon 21 Jun at 9am PT and include the technical checklist so Priya can confirm the acceptance tests on day 0.

I’ll notify Finance to hold off billing until we receive the PO number attached to the envelope.

-Kimberly

Kimberly — adding procurement and go/no-go timing from our side.

- Finance acceptance: We need the PO number and the signed SLA. Once we have the PO attached to the envelope, Finance will issue the internal billing trigger (same day) and Security will greenlight final provisioning (typically 6 hours after Finance trigger).
- Proposed go/no-go checkpoint: Fri 18 Jun 2027 10:00 AM PT. This gives us one business day after DocuSign completion to validate PO and kick provisioning early if everything is clean. If anything is outstanding by that checkpoint (PO absent, redline unresolved), we shift start date to Mon 28 Jun 2027 to avoid half-complete provisioning.

One operational detail: because RetailCo procurement processes with a 2pm ET cutoff, the Thu 10am PT send gives a narrow but workable window for same-day PO. If we want a safer cushion, we could move DocuSign send to Thu 8am PT (11am ET) which increases chance of same-day procurement. Tradeoff is EMEA/Asia recipients may be outside ideal windows.

I recommend: send Thu 08:00 PT (11:00 ET) sequential envelope. Set the go/no-go checkpoint for Fri 18 Jun 2027 10:00 AM PT. If legal returns a redline before Thu 5pm PT, we can still pause and adjust envelope.

-Karthik
